module_summary: Registered AXI-stream crosspoint switch: inputs and select are registered, then each output register indexes the input registers by its select field (no backpressure).

anchors.name: select_reg
anchors.why: Registered per-output source index choosing which input stream drives each output.

anchors.name: s_axis_tdata
anchors.why: Concatenated input stream payloads, registered into s_axis_tdata_reg.

anchors.name: s_axis_tvalid
anchors.why: Per-input valid bits, registered and routed to outputs.

anchors.name: m_axis_tdata
anchors.why: Per-output routed payload driven from m_axis_tdata_reg.

anchors.name: m_axis_tvalid
anchors.why: Per-output valid driven from routed valid register.

anchors.name: s_axis_tdata_reg
anchors.why: Input register stage for payload, indexed by select_reg for routing.

anchors.name: s_axis_tvalid_reg
anchors.why: Input valid register stage, cleared on reset, routed by select_reg.

groups.name: Input register stage
groups.description: Registers all input stream fields every cycle.

groups.name: Crosspoint routing
groups.description: Output registers index registered inputs by per-output select field.
